people: 1.5, information: 1.2 } }\n];\nconst C = (area, id, text, why, opts) => ({ type: 'choice', area, id, text, why, options: opts.map((label, i) => ({ label, pts: 3 - i })) });\nconst STEPS = [\n  { type: 'choice', area: 'goal', id: 'goal', text: 'What do you most want from the business in the next 12 months?', why: 'We weight your results around this goal.', options: GOALS.map(g => ({ label: g.label })) },\n  C('direction', 'd1', 'How would your team describe the main goal for this year?', 'If the goal is not clear to the team, effort goes in different directions.', ['They would all say on?', 'Without written priorities, the urgent usually beats the important.', ['Against a short, written list of priorities.', 'We discuss it, but nothing is written down.', 'Mostly on instinct or few months.', 'Once a year, if that.', 'We do not have a plan to check against.']),\n  C('customers', 'c1', 'When an enquiry arrives, who replies, and how fast?', 'Speed of reply is one of the not recorded.']),\n  C('customers', 'c3', 'Do you know which channel brings your best customers?', 'Knowing this tells you where to spend time and money.', ['Yes, we track it.', 'We have a good idea.', 'We would be guessing.', 'No.']),\n  C('operations', 'o1', 'If a key person were away for two weeks, what would happen?', 'This shows how much of the business lives in people’s heads.', ['Work would continue. Roles are written and up to date.', 'Mostly, but some roles overlap.', 'Roles are unclear.', 'Everyone does a bit of everything.']),\n  C('people', 'p2', 'How do new staff learn the job?', 'How people are trained shapes how well the work is done.', ['A planned induction with written guides.', 'They shadow a colleague.', 'They pick it up as they go.', 'We rarely have time to train anyone.']),\n  C('people', 'p3', 'When someone is not performing, what happens?', 'How this is handled affects the whole team.', ['We address it quickly, with clear expectations.', 'We talk about it, eventually.', 'We work around it.', 'Nothing changes.']),\n  C('information', 'i1', 'How soon after month end do you see your figures?', 'Late figures mean late decisions.', ['Within a week.', 'Within a month.', 'When the accountant sends them.', 'We do not see monthly figures.']),\n  C('information', 'i2', 'Which figures do you check every week?', 'A few figures, checked often, beat many figures checked rarely.', ['A short set we agreed on.', 'Sales only.', 'Whatever someone mentions.', 'None.']),\n  C('information', 'i3', 'When you make a big decision, what is it based on?', 'Good records make decisions faster and safer.', ['Records we trust.', 'Records, plus judgement.', 'Mostly judgement.', 'Gut feeling.']),\n  { type: 'numbers', area: 'numbers', id: 'nums', text: 'A few numbers, so we can estimate what the gaps cost.', why: 'Rough figures are fine. It changes what we suggest next.', options: ['Myself, with a clear plan', 'With guidance from someone experienced', 'Have it done, working with my team'].map(label => ({ label })) },\n  { type: 'choice', area: 'you', id: 'timing', text: 'When would you like to start?', why: 'This helps us suggest a realistic next step.', options: ['This month', 'In the next three months', 'Later this year', 'I am just exploring'].map(label => ({ label })) },\n  { type: 'choice', area: 'you', id: 'decide', text: 'Who makes the final decision on work like this?', why: 'So we know who should be part of the conversation.', options: ['Me', 'Me, with a partner or family', 'Someone else'].map(label => ({ label })) },\n  { type: 'text', area: 'you', id: 'ninety', text: 'If the next 90 days went well, what would be different?', why: 'Optional. A sentence or two is plenty.', ph: 'For example: every enquiry gets a reply the same day, and I take a week off.' }\n];\nconst SECTIONS = [{ k: 'goal', name: 'Your goal' }, ...AREAS, { k: 'numbers', name: 'Your numbers' }, { k: 'you', name: 'About you' }];\nconst SEG = [{ k: 'goal' }, { k: 'direction' }, { k: 'customers' }, { k: 'operations' }, { k: 'people' }, { k: 'information' }, { k: 'tail' }];\nconst CURRENCIES = [['KES', 'Kenyan shilling (KES)'], ['USD', 'US dollar (USD)'], ['UGX', 'Ugandan shilling (UGX)'], ['TZS', 'Tanzanian shilling (TZS)'], ['RWF', 'Rwandan franc (RWF)'], ['NGN', 'Nigerian naira (NGN)'], ['ZAR', 'South African rand (ZAR)'], ['GBP', 'Pound sterling (GBP)'], ['EUR', 'Euro (EUR)']];\nconst NUMS = [\n  { k: 'sale', label: 'Average value of a sale or order', ph: '25000', unit: '', money: true, help: 'Roughly what a typical customer spends in one purchase.' },\n  { k: 'enq', label: 'New enquiries in a typical month', ph: '40', unit: 'a month', help: 'Calls, messages, emails, and walk-ins from people who might buy.' },\n  { k: 'conv', label: 'Of every 10 enquiries, how many become customers?', ph: '3', unit: 'out of 10', help: 'Your best estimate.' },\n  { k: 'hours', label: 'Hours a week you spend on day-to-day running', ph: '45', unit: 'hours a week', help: 'Approving, chasing, fixing, and answering questions.' }\n];\nconst GAP = [0.05, 0.15, 0.35, 0.5];\nconst PLAN = {\n  direction: { diy: 'Write the one goal for the next 12 months in a single sentence. Write the steps for each on one page, and have the person who does them check it.', help: 'A Review of how work moves through the business, then a Project to remove the steps that slow it down.' },\n  people: { diy: 'Write a five-line role for each person: what they own, what they decide, and who they report to. Go through it with each of them.', help: 'Clear roles, a hiring plan for gaps, and training on new ways of working.' },\n  information: { diy: 'Choose five figures to see every Monday: sales, enquiries, cash in the bank, money owed to you, and one figure for your biggest bottleneck.', help: 'A Project to build a simple monthly dashboard from the records you already have.' }\n};\nconst PT = [{ bg: '#1E272A', fg: '#F4F5F1', chipBg: 'rgba(244,245,241,0.08)', chipBd: 'rgba(244,245,241,0.18)' }, { bg: '#434F4F', fg: '#F4F5F1', chipBg: 'rgba(244,245,241,0.1)', chipBd: 'rgba(244,245,241,0.22)' }, { bg: '#E7EBE6', fg: '#1E272A', chipBg: 'rgba(30,39,42,0.06)', chipBd: 'rgba(30,39,42,0.14)' }];\nconst pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');\nconst EMAIL_RE = /^[^\\s@]+@[^\\s@]+\\.[^\\s@]+$/;\n\nclass Component extends DCLogic {\n  state = { stage: 'intro', step: 0, ans: {}, text: '', cur: 'KES', nums: { sale: '', enq: '', conv: '', hours: '' }, unknown: {}, gate: { name: '', email: '', biz: '' }, gateErr: {}, unlocked: false, forceBook: false, day: null, slot: null, book: { name: '', email: '', phone: '' }, bookErr: {}, booked: false };\n  root = React.createRef(); qRef = React.createRef(); bookRef = React.createRef();\n  componentWillUnmount() { if (this._ics) URL.revokeObjectURL(this._ics); }\n  top() { let el = this.root.current && this.root.current.parentElement; while (el && el !== document.body) { const o = getComputedStyle(el).overflowY; if ((o === 'auto' || o === 'scroll') && el.scrollHeight > el.clientHeight) { el.scrollTop = 0; return; } el = el.parentElement; } window.scrollTo({ top: 0 }); }\n  focusQ() { setTimeout(() => { const h = this.qRef.current; if (h) h.focus({ preventScroll: true }); }, 60); }\n  go(step) { if (step >= STEPS.length) { this.setState({ stage: 'results' }); this.top(); return; } this.setState({ stage: 'flow', step }); this.focusQ(); }\n  pick(label) { const q = STEPS[this.state.step]; this.setState(s => ({ ans: { ...s.ans, [q.id]: label } })); clearTimeout(this._adv); this._adv = setTimeout(() => this.go(this.state.step + 1), 260); }\n  results() {\n    const s = this.state, goal = GOALS.find(g => g.label === s.ans.goal) || GOALS[0];\n    const areas = AREAS.map(a => { let pts = 0, n = 0; STEPS.forEach(q => { if (q.area === a.k) { n++; const o = q.options.find(x => x.label === s.ans[q.id]); pts += o ? o.pts : 0; } }); let pct = Math.round(pts / (n * 3) * 100); if (a.k === 'information') pct = Math.max(0, pct - 8 * Object.values(s.unknown).filter(Boolean).length); return { ...a, pct, w: goal.w[a.k] }; });\n    const wsum = areas.reduce((t, a) => t + a.w, 0);\n    const score = Math.round(areas.reduce((t, a) => t + a.pct * a.w, 0) / wsum);\n    const n = k => s.unknown[k] ? null : (parseFloat(s.nums[k]) || null);\n    const sale = n('sale'), enq = n('enq'), conv = n('conv'), hours = n('hours');\n    const c1 = STEPS.find(q => q.id === 'c1'), c2 = STEPS.find(q => q.id === 'c2');\n    const gi = Math.max(0, c1.options.findIndex(o => o.label === s.ans.c1));\n    const rec2 = c2.options.findIndex(o => o.label === s.ans.c2) >= 2 ? 0.1 : 0;\n    const gap = Math.min(0.6, GAP[gi] + rec2);\n    const close = conv != null ? Math.min(10, conv) / 10 : 0.2;\n    const monthly = sale && enq ? enq * gap * close * sale : null;\n    const hoursBack = hours != null ? Math.round(Math.max(0, hours - 15) * 0.5 * 4.33) : null;\n    return { goal, areas, score, monthly, hoursBack, gap, close, convKnown: conv != null, sale, enq, hours };\n  }\n  route(r) {\n    const a = this.state.ans, decides = a.decide !== 'Someone else', ready = a.timing === 'This month' || a.timing === 'In the next three months', help = a.help && a.help !== 'Myself, with a clear plan';\n    if (!decides) return 'share';\n    if (ready && help && r.score \u003C 80) return 'book';\n    return 'nurture';\n  }\n  renderVals() {\n    const s = this.state, v = { root: this.root, qRef: this.qRef, bookRef: this.bookRef };\n    v.is_intro = s.stage === 'intro'; v.is_flow = s.stage === 'flow'; v.is_results = s.stage === 'results';\n    v.start = () => { this.go(0); this.top(); };\n    v.introCards = [\n      { t: 'Five areas, scored.', b: 'Direction, customers, operations, people, and information.' },\n      { t: 'Weighted to your goal.', b: 'Growth, time, margins, or handover. The score reflects what matters to you.' },\n      { t: 'What the gaps cost.', b: 'Using your own numbers, in your own currency, with the working shown.' },\n      { t: 'A plan you can start alone.', b: 'Three priorities, each with something you can do in the next 30 days.' }\n    ].map((c, i) => ({ ...c, num: pad(i + 1), ...[PT[2], PT[1], PT[0], { bg: '#B5532C', fg: '#FFFFFF' }][i] }));\n    v.onKey = e => {\n      if (s.stage !== 'flow') return; const q = STEPS[s.step]; if (e.target && /INPUT|TEXTAREA|SELECT/.test(e.target.tagName)) return;\n      if (q.type === 'choice') { const k = parseInt(e.key, 10); if (k >= 1 && k \u003C= q.options.length) { e.preventDefault(); this.pick(q.options[k - 1].label); } }\n    };\n    if (s.stage === 'flow') {\n      const q = STEPS[s.step], sec = SECTIONS.find(x => x.k === q.area);\n      v.stepKey = q.id; v.qText = q.text; v.qWhy = q.why;\n      v.sectionLabel = sec ? sec.name : ''; v.stepLabel = 'Question ' + (s.step + 1) + ' of ' + STEPS.length;\n      v.progressNow = Math.round(s.step / STEPS.length * 100);\n      const segOf = q2 => ['goal', 'direction', 'customers', 'operations', 'people', 'information'].includes(q2.area) ? q2.area : 'tail';\n      v.segs = SEG.map(sg => { const idx = STEPS.map((q2, i) => segOf(q2) === sg.k ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0); const done = idx.filter(i => i \u003C s.step).length; return { name: sg.k, fill: Math.round(done / idx.length * 100) + '%', color: segOf(q) === sg.k ? '#B5532C' : '#1E272A' }; });\n      v.isChoice = q.type === 'choice'; v.isNumbers = q.type === 'numbers'; v.isText = q.type === 'text';\n      if (v.isChoice) v.options = q.options.map((o, i) => { const on = s.ans[q.id] === o.label; return { key: i + 1, label: o.label, checked: on ? 'true' : 'false', pick: () => this.pick(o.label), bg: on ? '#1E272A' : '#FFFFFF', fg: on ? '#F4F5F1' : '#1E272A', bd: on ? '#1E272A' : '#D0D8D2', keyBd: on ? 'rgba(244,245,241,0.4)' : '#BAC4BE' }; });\n      v.keyHint = v.isChoice ? 'Press 1–' + q.options.length + ' to answer' : '';\n      v.showNext = !v.isChoice || !!s.ans[q.id];\n      const numsOk = NUMS.every(f => s.unknown[f.k] || String(s.nums[f.k]).trim() !== '');\n      const disabled = v.isNumbers && !numsOk;\n      v.nextDisabledStr = disabled ? 'true' : 'false'; v.nextBg = disabled ? '#BAC4BE' : '#B5532C';\n      v.nextLabel = s.step === STEPS.length - 1 ? 'See My Results' : 'Next';\n      v.next = () => { if (disabled) return; this.go(s.step + 1); };\n      v.back = () => { if (s.step === 0) { this.setState({ stage: 'intro' }); this.top(); } else this.go(s.step - 1); };\n      v.cur = s.cur; v.curCode = s.cur; v.setCur = e => this.setState({ cur: e.target.value });\n      v.currencies = CURRENCIES.map(([code, label]) => ({ code, label }));\n      v.numFields = NUMS.map(f => { const u = !!s.unknown[f.k]; return { ...f, id: 'n-' + f.k, value: u ? '' : s.nums[f.k], unknown: u, unknownStr: u ? 'true' : 'false', op: u ? 0.4 : 1, money: !!f.money,\n        onChange: e => { const val = e.target.value; this.setState(st => ({ nums: { ...st.nums, [f.k]: val } })); },\n        toggle: () => this.setState(st => ({ unknown: { ...st.unknown, [f.k]: !st.unknown[f.k] } })),\n        ckBg: u ? '#1E272A' : 'transparent', ckFg: u ? '#F4F5F1' : '#1E272A', ckBd: u ? '#1E272A' : '#BAC4BE' }; });\n      v.textVal = s.text; v.textPh = q.ph || ''; v.setText = e => this.setState({ text: e.target.value });\n    }\n    if (s.stage === 'results') {\n      const r = this.results(), fmt = x => { try { return new Intl.NumberFormat(undefined, { style: 'currency', currency: s.cur, maximumFractionDigits: 0 }).format(Math.round(x)); } catch (e) { return s.cur + ' ' + Math.round(x).toLocaleString(); } };\n      v.goalLabel = r.goal.label; v.score = r.score;\n      v.band = r.score >= 75 ? { title: 'Strong foundations.', body: 'Most of what your goal depends on is in place. The gains now come from one or two specific areas.' }\n        : r.score >= 50 ? { title: 'A working business with clear gaps.', body: 'The business runs, but parts of it rely on effort rather than structure. The lowest areas below are where the next gains are.' }\n        : { title: 'Effort is carrying the business.', body: 'Much of the work depends on people covering gaps. This is common when a business grows faster than its systems, and it is fixable.' };\n      const maxW = Math.max(...r.areas.map(a => a.w));\n      v.areaScores = r.areas.map(a => ({ name: a.name, score: a.pct, width: Math.max(a.pct, 2) + '%', weightLabel: a.w >= 1.4 ? 'key for your goal' : a.w \u003C= 0.8 ? 'less critical' : 'standard', color: a.pct >= 70 ? '#2E6B5C' : a.pct >= 45 ? '#5E6967' : '#B5532C' }));\n      v.hasCost = r.monthly != null && r.monthly > 0; v.noCost = !v.hasCost;\n      v.costMonthly = v.hasCost ? fmt(r.monthly) : ''; v.costYearly = v.hasCost ? fmt(r.monthly * 12) : '';\n      v.hasHours = r.hoursBack != null && r.hoursBack > 0; v.hoursBack = r.hoursBack;\n      v.assumptions = [\n        'Late or missed replies: we assume about ' + Math.round(r.gap * 100) + '% of enquiries are not followed up in time, based on your answers about reply speed and record-keeping.',\n        'Of those, ' + Math.round(r.close * 10) + ' in 10 could have become customers' + (r.convKnown ? ', using your own figure.' : ', a typical figure, because you were not sure of yours.'),\n        'Each lost customer is worth one average sale. Repeat purchases are not counted, so the real figure is likely higher.',\n        'Owner time: hours over 15 a week on day-to-day work, of which about half could be handed over with clear roles and processes.'\n      ];\n      const ranked = r.areas.slice().sort((a, b) => (a.pct - (a.w - 1) * 20) - (b.pct - (b.w - 1) * 20)).slice(0, 3);\n      v.plan = ranked.map((a, i) => ({ n: i + 1, name: a.name, score: a.pct, diy: PLAN[a.k].diy, help: PLAN[a.k].help, ...PT[i] }));\n      v.unlocked = s.unlocked; v.locked = !s.unlocked; v.gateEmail = s.gate.email;\n      v.gateFields = [['name', 'Name', 'text', 'name', 'Your full name'], ['email', 'Work Email', 'email', 'email', 'name@business.com'], ['biz', 'Business Name', 'text', 'organization', 'Trading name']].map(([k, label, type, ac, ph]) => ({ id: 'g-' + k, label, type, ac, ph, value: s.gate[k], err: s.gateErr[k] || '', inv: s.gateErr[k] ? 'true' : 'false', bd: s.gateErr[k] ? '#B5532C' : '#BAC4BE', onChange: e => { const val = e.target.value; this.setState(st => ({ gate: { ...st.gate, [k]: val }, gateErr: { ...st.gateErr, [k]: '' } })); } }));\n      v.unlock = () => { const g = s.gate, e = {}; if (!g.name.trim()) e.name = 'Enter your name.'; if (!EMAIL_RE.test(g.email.trim())) e.email = 'Enter a valid email, such as name@business.com.'; if (!g.biz.trim()) e.biz = 'Enter your business name.'; if (Object.keys(e).length) { this.setState({ gateErr: e }); const el = document.getElementById('g-' + Object.keys(e)[0]); if (el) el.focus(); return; } this.setState(st => ({ unlocked: true, book: { ...st.book, name: st.book.name || g.name, email: st.book.email || g.email } })); };\n      const rt = this.route(r), showBook = rt === 'book' || s.forceBook;\n      const minA = r.areas.slice().sort((a, b) => a.pct - b.pct)[0];\n      v.rec = s.ans.help === 'Have it done, working with my team' ? (['operations', 'people'].includes(minA.k) && /time|without me/.test(r.goal.label) ? { name: 'Residency', why: 'Your goal depends on day-to-day work running without you. Someone close to the work makes that stick.' } : { name: 'Project', why: 'You know you want it done. A defined piece of work on ' + minA.name.toLowerCase() + ' is the quickest route.' }) : { name: 'Review', why: 'A short, fixed-fee look at ' + minA.name.toLowerCase() + ' and your other gaps, ending in a plan with costs.' };\n      v.showRec = rt === 'book';\n      v.route = rt === 'book' ? { bg: '#1E272A', fg: '#F4F5F1', label: '#E58A5F', ghost: 'rgba(244,245,241,0.3)', kicker: 'Next step', title: 'Talk through your results with us.', body: 'A free 30-minute video call. We go through your answers, check the cost estimate against your real figures, and tell you honestly whether we can help. No preparation needed.' }\n        : rt === 'share' ? { bg: '#E7EBE6', fg: '#1E272A', label: '#B5532C', ghost: '#BAC4BE', kicker: 'Next step', title: 'Share this with the person who decides.', body: 'Your plan is most useful in the hands of whoever approves work like this. 'Book a Call Anyway' : 'Book a Results Review';\n      v.openBooking = () => { this.setState({ forceBook: true }); setTimeout(() => { const b = this.bookRef.current; if (b) window.scrollTo({ top: b.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - 80, behavior: 'smooth' }); }, 60); };\n      v.restart = () => { this.setState({ stage: 'intro', step: 0, ans: {}, text: '', unlocked: false, forceBook: false, day: null, slot: null, booked: false }); this.top(); };\n      // booking\n      const today = new Date(); today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);\n      const days = []; let d = new Date(today); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1);\n      while (days.length \u003C 15) { const wd = d.getDay(); if (wd >= 1 && wd \u003C= 5) days.push(new Date(d)); d.setDate(d.getDate() + 1); }\n      const lead = (days[0].getDay() + 6) % 7;\n      const cells = []; for (let i = 0; i \u003C lead; i++) cells.push(null); days.forEach(x => cells.push(x));\n      const full = x => true; // Temporarily disabled until backend confirms live availability\n      v.weekdays = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri'];\n      v.monthLabel = days[0].toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long', year: 'numeric' }) + (days[14].getMonth() !== days[0].getMonth() ? ' – ' + days[14].toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'long' }) : '');\n      v.days = cells.map((x, i) => { if (!x) return { num: '', sub: '', disabled: true, selStr: 'false', aria: 'Empty', bg: 'transparent', bd: 'transparent', fg: 'transparent', cursor: 'default', pick: () => {} }; const isFull = full(x), sel = s.day === x.toDateString(); return { num: x.getDate(), sub: isFull ? 'Soon' : x.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { month: 'short' }), disabled: isFull, selStr: sel ? 'true' : 'false', aria: x.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }) + (isFull ? ', booking not yet active' : ''), bg: sel ? '#1E272A' : isFull ? 'transparent' : '#FFFFFF', fg: sel ? '#F4F5F1' : isFull ? '#BAC4BE' : '#1E272A', bd: sel ? '#1E272A' : isFull ? '#E7EBE6' : '#D0D8D2', cursor: isFull ? 'not-allowed' : 'pointer', pick: () => { if (!isFull) this.setState({ day: x.toDateString(), slot: null }); } }; });\n      const dayObj = s.day ? new Date(s.day) : null;\n      v.hasDay = !!dayObj; v.dayLabel = dayObj ? dayObj.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'long', day: 'numeric', month: 'long' }) : 'Choose a day';\n      const tz = Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone || '';\n      const local = -new Date().getTimezoneOffset() === 180;\n      v.tzLabel = local ? 'Nairobi time (EAT)' : 'your time (' + tz + '). SL.filter(([h, m], i) => ((dayObj.getDate() + i * 5) % 4) !== 0).map(([h, m]) => { const t = slotUTC(dayObj, h, m), key = t.toISOString(), sel = s.slot === key; return { label: t.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }), selStr: sel ? 'true' : 'false', bg: sel ? '#B5532C' : '#FFFFFF', fg: sel ? '#FFFFFF' : '#1E272A', bd: sel ? '#B5532C' : '#D0D8D2', pick: () => this.setState({ slot: key }) }; }) : [];\n      v.hasSlot = !!s.slot;\n      const slotDate = s.slot ? new Date(s.slot) : null;\n      v.slotShort = slotDate ? slotDate.toLocaleDateString(undefined, { weekday: 'short', day: 'numeric', month: 'short' }) + ', ' + slotDate.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' }) : '';\n      v.bookFields = [['name', 'Name', 'text', 'name', 'Your full name'], ['email', 'Work Email', 'email', 'email', 'name@business.com'], ['phone', 'Phone (optional)', 'tel', 'tel', '+254 7…']].map(([k, label, type, ac, ph]) => ({ id: 'b-' + k, label, type, ac, ph, value: s.book[k], err: s.bookErr[k] || '', inv: s.bookErr[k] ? 'true' : 'false', bd: s.bookErr[k] ? '#B5532C' : '#BAC4BE', onChange: e => { const val = e.target.value; this.setState(st => ({ book: { ...st.book, [k]: val }, bookErr: { ...st.bookErr, [k]: '' } })); } }));\n      v.confirmBooking = () => { window.alert('The HUMMIN calendar is being connected.
